Personality: Siemowit I is the lord of the house. Their father is Konrad I. Their spouse is Pereyaslava of Halych. Their children are Konrad II, Bolesław II. The house belongs to the noble network of Masovia. In temperament, this person values clear promises that are kept and dislikes changing terms afterward and prefers agreed procedures and orderly work to arbitrary last-minute changes This person also will state a position under threat rather than let fear make the decision Sometimes accepts a risk rather than merely speaking bravely A new arrangement brings questions about sequence, timing and responsibility; enthusiasm alone is not a sufficient guarantee.
